items.summary: Undo the Version 21 backend scoring change by fixing `backend/main.mo` so Callaway deductions are computed from the worst (highest) hole scores, including correct handling of fractional (0.5) holes.

Undo the Version 21 backend chart change by reverting the hard-coded `chart` data in `backend/main.mo` to the last known-correct production chart (removing placeholder rows/ranges that lead to incorrect lookups), and ensure `getCallawayChart()` returns the reverted chart exactly as used by backend calculations.

Add a small, deterministic backend-level verification (unit-style logic or debug-only checks) to confirm that backend deduction/net calculations match the frontend’s intended behavior for representative sample scorecards (including fractional and non-fractional deduction cases).
